name: Saffron and the End of the World
source:
You're a baking witch living in a barren magical world, abandoned by occupants who fled from a terrible curse that affects non-witches. 

You piece together the courage to keep living day by day, the only joy in your life being your long-distance witch girlfriend, who you contact through your crystal ball. But the humans want their normal lives back too, and they will do anything to end the curse, even if that means destroying you in the process. 

Can you reunite with your girlfriend one last time before it's too late?

[From [url=https://lunarlichen.itch.io/saffron-and-the-end-of-the-world]itch.io[/url]]
